timeline.headline: Realized Gain gets real
timeline.text: The codebase was reorganized into per-feature folders. Realized Gain picked up goal tracking, historical stats and multi-scenario projections, plus its first unit tests. The Home page was redesigned, and Bank Details got its first real BRACBANK figures.

timeline.headline: Newspaper and a world map
timeline.text: The Newspaper launched — self-published editions, a world map, Bengali translation, per-stock historical scraping. The candlestick chart gained a TradingView-style sidebar with Analysis, Valuation and S&R panels, and Demo Trade and Currency Portfolio came online.

timeline.headline: Research Report and Economic Impact
timeline.text: Two new pages — Research Report and Economic Impact — plus technical scans in the Screener, trade markers and mutual-fund holder info on the candlestick chart, and a turnover breakdown modal on Trades.

timeline.headline: Pushing the price history back to 2015
timeline.text: A quiet week: historical price data extended back to 2015, with a handful of new analysis tools alongside it.

timeline.headline: Navigation, sector guides, live watchlist
timeline.text: The nav menu was redesigned into grouped sections. Sector guide pages and learning-progress tracking joined the Learning Hub, the Newspaper got self-published editions and world-news scraping, Big Data gained bank peer EPS comparison, and the watchlist panel was hardened to keep live prices in sync.

timeline.headline: The 36-bank financial dataset, built in a week
timeline.text: The project's biggest single push: a 15-year (2011–2026) quarterly financial archive for every DSE-listed bank, built and backfilled name by name, plus cross-bank benchmarking and quality scoring. Alongside it: a site-wide Settings engine, a device sign-in gate that stopped serving private files, the static-site publish pipeline to GitHub Pages, and a mobile pass across every page.

timeline.headline: Random Strategies hub
timeline.text: The week opens with an MCDA dividend scorer and a real-bank ranking tool, folded into a new Random Strategies hub.
